title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes and kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease stage 4. He reports feeling stable overall but notes mild fatigue. He has been on a long-term insulin regimen for several years. He reports adherence to his current treatment plan and denies any recent acute issues or significant changes in his renal function.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Skin is intact. Heart sounds are regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No edema noted in lower extremities.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4.

Plan
1. Continue current insulin therapy.
2. Monitor renal function and electrolyte levels.
3. Follow up in three months for repeat labs and clinical evaluation.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
